newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares end higher, property stocks lead.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares end higher, property stocks lead.

text.p: The Singapore share index closed sharply higher on Tuesday with property stocks and selected blue chips posting smart advances.
Heavyweight City Developments jumped 70 cents higher to S$12.20 pushing the SES Property index up 2.62 percent or 17.58 points to 688.17.
The key Straits Times Industrials Index also soared to close at the day's high of 2,189.05, up 34.56 points.
Dealers said the gains were made on the back of the strong performance in Wall Street. "If Wall Street continued its current course, Singapore could reach 2,250," said one dealer.
But some dealers cautioned that the rally was not expected to last. "The strength is patchy and is not expected to last," said an institutional dealer with a foreign firm.
"It's like bouncing on the trampoline -- the jumps get bigger and falls steeper, but always touching the same bottom," he said.
Market volume was an active 146.37 million shares but the overall market was weak with 207 losers swamping 144 gainers.
Singapore Telecom 100 and SingTel were among top losers, falling between Singapore $0.12 and S$0.08 respectively on profit-taking after the second tranche of shares were listed.
